extra.final_summary:
Units sold per region: West 62, South 53, North 40, East 28 (all 43 rows used).

Problems found and fixes:
- Region had 9 distinct labels instead of the 4 allowed ones: case variants "north" (2 rows) and "east" (1 row), plus misspellings "Nort" (→North), "Suoth" (→South), "Wst" (→West). Fixed with one normalize_labels call (approved); no rows were excluded for label spelling.
- Quantity (the metric) was checked: no missing values, no negatives, nothing below the rules minimum of 1, no numbers stored as text. No fix needed.
- No exact duplicate rows.

Caveats (not used by this question, so left untouched):
- Date has ~7% non-ISO values (e.g. row 8 "2026-14-01" is an impossible month) — would need parse_dates if a date-based question comes up.
- Price is stored as text with 3 values written as currency ("$6.00", "$350.00") — would need cast_numeric for revenue/price analysis.
- Revenue was not verified against Quantity * Price; it isn't needed for a unit count.
